name: job-search-os
description: Claude-driven operating system for a serious job search. Ten skills (Onboarding, Brief, Scout, Drafter, Researcher, Tailor, Builder, Coach, Ops, Synth) act as a chief-of-staff team. Run /job-search-os:onboarding once to set up everything; thereafter the system drafts outreach, researches contacts, tailors resumes, runs mock interviews, and produces daily briefings.
